task: Where is the z-order of shapes implemented? Point me at the core function, the per-type wrappers, and the UI buttons.

steps.goal: Identify the core z-order implementation function(s) in src/board/zorder.ts and report their names, signatures, and line ranges.
steps.edit_spec: Report all top-level entity names, especially exported functions, with their signatures and line ranges.

steps.goal: Identify the UI buttons/components in src/board/toolbars.tsx responsible for z-order actions (bring forward, send backward, bring to front, send to back).
steps.edit_spec: Report entity names and line ranges for any toolbar buttons that trigger z-order changes, including their labels or icon identifiers.

steps.goal: Identify per-type z-order wrapper functions in src/board/useShapes.ts that delegate to the core z-order function.
steps.edit_spec: Report entity names and line ranges for functions that call into zorder.ts or manipulate shape z-order arrays, e.g. bringShapeToFront or sendShapeToBack.

steps.goal: Identify per-type z-order wrapper functions in src/board/useStickyNotes.ts that delegate to the core z-order function.
